items.title: koala73/worldmonitor
items.description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational awareness interface
items.author: koala73
items.summary_zh: 这是一个基于AI的实时全球情报仪表盘，能够聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件并追踪基础设施状态，用户可以通过统一的界面全面了解世界动态。它的价值在于为需要快速掌握全球局势的分析师、记者和企业决策者提供了强大的实时信息工具。
items.summary_en: Worldmonitor is an AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard that aggregates news, monitors geopolitical events, and tracks infrastructure status in a single unified view. Designed for analysts, journalists, and business leaders, it enables rapid situational awareness and informed decision-making by consolidating diverse data streams into an accessible interface. Its significance lies in simplifying complex global monitoring and helping professionals stay ahead of critical developments.

items.title: ocornut/imgui
items.description: Dear ImGui: Bloat-free Graphical User interface for C++ with minimal dependencies
items.author: ocornut
items.summary_zh: Dear ImGui 是一个专为C++开发者设计的轻量级图形用户界面库，以“无臃肿”为核心理念，拥有极少的依赖项，方便集成到任何项目中。它采用即时模式架构，特别适合游戏引擎工具、调试界面或快速原型开发，让程序员无需引入庞大框架就能轻松创建交互式面板。由于其灵活性和低开销，它在游戏开发者、嵌入式系统工程师以及各类工具链维护者中广受欢迎，成为构建高效、可定制UI的务实选择。
items.summary_en: Dear ImGui is a lightweight, bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ with minimal dependencies, designed for developers who need a quick and flexible UI layer. Its immediate-mode approach makes it ideal for game engine tools, debugging panels, and rapid prototyping, allowing programmers to build interactive dashboards without adopting heavyweight frameworks. Widely adopted by game developers, embedded engineers, and toolchain creators, it stands out for its efficiency, low overhead, and ease of integration, solving the problem of UI bloat in performance-sensitive applications.

items.title: ocornut/imgui
items.description: Dear ImGui: Bloat-free Graphical User interface for C++ with minimal dependencies
items.author: ocornut
items.summary_zh: Dear ImGui是一个极简主义的C++图形用户界面库，几乎没有外部依赖，却能实现流畅的即时模式界面。它特别适合游戏开发工具、调试面板和实时数据可视化场景，因为开发者不需要复杂的UI框架就能快速构建交互界面。相比传统UI库，它更注重开发效率和灵活性，因此在独立游戏和工具链中广受欢迎。
items.summary_en: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ with minimal dependencies, offering a seamless immediate mode GUI experience. It is especially popular among game developers and tool builders who need quick, interactive panels for debugging or real-time data visualization without the overhead of traditional UI frameworks. Its focus on simplicity and performance makes it a go-to choice for indie games and embedded tools.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6-Sol, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.title: NanmiCoder/MediaCrawler
items.description: 小红书笔记 | 评论爬虫、抖音视频 | 评论爬虫、快手视频 | 评论爬虫、B 站视频 ｜ 评论爬虫、微博帖子 ｜ 评论爬虫、百度贴吧帖子 ｜ 百度贴吧评论回复爬虫 | 知乎问答文章｜评论爬虫
items.author: NanmiCoder
items.summary_zh: 这是一个多平台社交媒体爬虫工具，支持小红书、抖音、快手、B站、微博、百度贴吧和知乎，能抓取笔记、视频、帖子及评论。对于需要做舆情分析、竞品研究或数据挖掘的人来说，它把散落在各平台的公开内容集中抓取，省去了自己写爬虫的麻烦。
items.summary_en: MediaCrawler is a multi-platform social media scraper covering Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Weibo, Baidu Tieba, and Zhihu, extracting posts, videos, and comments. It's a goldmine for market researchers, data analysts, and content creators who need public data from China's top platforms without building individual crawlers.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
items.author: mvanhorn
items.summary_zh: 这是一个AI代理技能，能够跨Reddit、X、YouTube、Hacker News、Polymarket及整个网络搜索任意主题，并综合生成有据可依的摘要。它的独特之处在于聚合多源信息后给出带引用的总结，把散落在各平台的观点和事实整合成一份可信的简报。非常适合需要快速掌握某个话题舆论动向或最新进展的研究者、记者和投资者。
items.summary_en: This is an AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the broader web, then synthesizes a grounded summary with citations. Its strength lies in aggregating fragmented information from diverse platforms into a single, credible briefing, complete with references. This is a game-changer for researchers, journalists, and investors who need to quickly grasp the pulse of public opinion or the latest developments on a subject without manually combing through dozens of tabs.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
items.author: pbakaus
items.summary_zh: Impeccable 是一套专门为 AI 设计工具量身打造的设计语言，旨在帮助 AI 更准确地理解和生成美观、一致的用户界面。它定义了清晰的视觉规范、布局原则和交互模式，让 AI 在设计输出时不再“胡乱发挥”，而是遵循人类设计师的直觉和标准。无论是设计自动化工具、低代码平台还是智能助手，Impeccable 都能显著提升 AI 产出的设计质量，降低后期人工修正成本。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design language crafted specifically for AI-powered design tools, helping AI better understand and generate visually appealing, consistent user interfaces. By defining clear visual specifications, layout principles, and interaction patterns, it stops AI from producing chaotic results and instead aligns its output with human designer intuition. For design automation tools, low-code platforms, or smart assistants, Impeccable significantly improves the quality of AI-generated designs and reduces the need for manual adjustments.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
items.author: usestrix
items.summary_zh: Strix是一款开源的AI渗透测试工具，能够自动扫描并修复应用中的安全漏洞。它利用人工智能模拟攻击行为，帮助开发者在早期发现潜在风险，大幅提升安全检测效率。对于缺乏专业安全团队的初创公司和个人开发者来说，Strix提供了一种低成本、高效率的防护方案，让应用安全不再成为短板。
items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing tool designed to automatically identify and fix vulnerabilities in applications. By simulating cyber attacks with artificial intelligence, it helps developers catch security flaws early in the development cycle, significantly reducing manual effort and cost. This tool is particularly valuable for startups and individual developers who lack dedicated security teams, offering a practical way to strengthen app security without complex infrastructure. Its open-source nature also allows the community to contribute and customize it for specific needs.

items.title: moeru-ai/airi
items.description: 💖🧸 Self hosted, you-owned Grok Companion, a container of souls of waifu, cyber livings to bring them into our worlds, wishing to achieve Neuro-sama's altitude. Capable of realtime voice chat, Minecraft, Factorio playing. Web / macOS / Windows supported.
items.author: moeru-ai
items.summary_zh: Airi 是一个自托管的 AI 伴侣项目，灵感来自 Grok 和 Neuro-sama，让用户拥有完全属于自己的数字灵魂容器。它可以在本地运行一个可自定义的虚拟角色，支持对话、情感模拟和扩展功能，对于 AI 爱好者和开发者来说，提供了一个高度自由且保护隐私的个性化数字伴侣起点。
items.summary_en: Airi is a self-hosted AI companion inspired by Grok and Neuro-sama, designed to give users full ownership of their virtual digital soul. It runs locally, offering customizable chat, emotional simulation, and extensible capabilities. Developers and AI enthusiasts seeking a privacy-respecting, personalized digital companion can use Airi to experiment with AI personalities, integrate with other systems, and create unique interactive experiences, all while keeping data on their own hardware.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.description: High-performance code intelligence MCP server. Indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph — average repo in milliseconds. 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens. Single static binary, zero dependencies.
items.author: DeusData
items.summary_zh: 这是一个高性能的代码智能MCP服务器，能将整个代码库索引成持久化的知识图谱，支持158种语言，平均查询响应时间仅为毫秒级。它极大地提升了开发者在大型项目中快速理解代码结构的能力，尤其适合复杂代码库的维护和重构场景。
items.summary_en: This MCP server indexes entire codebases into a persistent knowledge graph with sub-millisecond latency, supporting 158 languages. It enables developers to rapidly understand code structure, dependencies, and history — a game-changer for navigating large, legacy, or unfamiliar repositories. Perfect for teams doing code reviews, refactoring, or onboarding.

items.title: 优衣库一边关店，一边赚钱
items.summary_zh: 优衣库正经历一种看似矛盾的局面：一边关闭低效门店，收缩实体网络，一边却实现利润增长。这背后是其对库存管理和线上线下融合的精准把控，通过优化单店效率和发力电商，将关店节省的成本转化为更高盈利。这种“减店增效”策略反映了后疫情时代零售业的理性趋势，不再盲目扩张，而是聚焦于运营质量和品牌忠诚度，对快消行业具有参考价值。
items.summary_en: Uniqlo is experiencing a paradoxical trend: closing underperforming physical stores while simultaneously posting rising profits. By improving store-level efficiency, tightening inventory management, and integrating online sales, the company turns cost savings from closures into higher margins. This 'less is more' strategy signals a rational shift in post-pandemic retail, moving away from expansion mania toward operational quality and brand loyalty. It offers a valuable lesson for the fast-fashion industry on how to balance digital channels with physical footprint for sustainable growth.

items.title: 8点1氪丨李斌现身长鑫科技答谢晚宴；瑞幸打赢“泰国瑞幸”，获赔近2000万；澳门政府发布美素佳儿奶粉铅超标事件最新检测结果
items.summary_zh: 本期8点1氪汇集三条重要新闻：蔚来创始人李斌现身长鑫科技答谢晚宴，或暗示双方在芯片领域的合作深化；瑞幸咖啡在与“泰国瑞幸”的商标侵权案中胜诉，获赔近2000万元，保护了其海外品牌权益；澳门政府公布美素佳儿奶粉铅超标事件最新检测结果，为消费者提供了安全警示。这些动态分别涉及汽车供应链、品牌维权和食品安全监管。
items.summary_en: This episode of 8点1氪 covers three major stories: NIO founder William Li appeared at CXMT's (ChangXin Memory Technologies) appreciation dinner, hinting at deeper collaboration in chips; Luckin Coffee won a trademark infringement case against a Thai copycat, securing nearly 20 million yuan in compensation and protecting its brand abroad; the Macau government released new test results on lead contamination in Friso baby formula, issuing a safety warning. These updates span electric-vehicle supply chains, intellectual property battles, and food safety regulation.

items.title: 长鑫上市，市值超3万亿，全球存储牌桌上迎来中国玩家
items.summary_zh: 长鑫存储（CXMT）正式上市，市值突破3万亿元，标志着中国在动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）领域迈入全球主要玩家行列。这家公司专注于自主研发的DRAM芯片，打破了海外巨头的垄断，对国产半导体产业链具有里程碑意义。其上市不仅为本土存储产业注入巨额资本，也意味着全球存储市场格局将迎来真正的中国竞争者，在技术、产能和价格方面都可能带来深远影响。
items.summary_en: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) has gone public with a market cap exceeding 3 trillion yuan, marking China's official entry as a major player in the global DRAM market. Specializing in self-developed memory chips, CXMT breaks the long-standing dominance of foreign giants like Samsung and SK Hynix. The listing injects massive capital into domestic semiconductor manufacturing, reshaping the global memory landscape. It signals that China can now compete on technology, capacity, and pricing, with implications for supply chain security and the balance of power in the memory industry.

items.title: 马斯克彻底向ASI投降，10年后万亿财富都将“归0”
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了马斯克对人工超级智能（ASI）态度的戏剧性转变——从早期警告AI风险到如今向ASI“投降”，并预言其万亿财富可能在十年内因ASI失控而归零。作者认为，即使像马斯克这样有远见的企业家，也无法抵挡ASI发展的洪流；他最终选择拥抱而非对抗，但即便如此，财富在ASI面前也可能化为乌有。这一观点引发了关于技术奇点和财富终结的深层讨论。
items.summary_en: This article explores Elon Musk's dramatic shift from warning about artificial superintelligence (ASI) to seemingly surrendering to it, predicting that his trillion-dollar fortune could vanish within a decade as ASI spirals beyond control. It argues that even a visionary like Musk cannot stem the tide of ASI development; his eventual embrace of the technology may be futile, as wealth becomes meaningless in the face of superintelligence. The piece sparks a deep conversation about the technological singularity, the fragility of human-made value, and the existential risks posed by unchecked AI advancement.

items.title: 刚刚，北大校友翁荔官宣离职，AI 时代最好的「对齐」是照顾好自己
items.summary_zh: 北大校友、AI安全领域知名研究者翁荔近日官宣离职，她在社交媒体上以一句“AI时代最好的对齐是照顾好自己”引发热议。这一表态将技术术语“对齐”重新定义为个人关怀，折射出AI从业者面对高强度竞争与伦理压力时的自我反思。她的离职不仅是个体职业选择，更象征着AI行业从追求技术对齐转向关注人性平衡，对理解当下AI人才生态具有重要启示。
items.summary_en: Weng Li, a well-known Peking University alumna and AI safety researcher, announced her departure, sparking discussion with her remark that 'the best alignment in the AI era is to take care of yourself.' By redefining the technical concept of 'alignment' as personal well-being, she highlights the burnout and ethical pressures faced by AI professionals. Her move reflects a shifting focus from technical alignment to human balance in the industry, offering a poignant glimpse into the current AI talent landscape.

items.title: 花260元救活一副AirPods Pro，我发现旧耳机将很难被淘汰了
items.summary_zh: 一位用户花费260元更换电池和扬声器，成功让一副旧的AirPods Pro“复活”，这一经历揭示了当前电子产品维修的可行性正在提升。随着第三方维修服务成熟和消费者环保意识增强，旧耳机不再轻易被淘汰。这不仅节省开支，还挑战了厂商鼓励换新的商业模式，预示着可持续消费趋势可能改变电子产品的生命周期。
items.summary_en: A user revived a pair of old AirPods Pro by spending just 260 yuan on battery and speaker replacements, demonstrating that repairing electronics is becoming more feasible. With mature third-party repair services and growing environmental awareness, old headphones no longer face easy obsolescence. This not only saves money but also challenges manufacturers' upgrade-driven business models, signaling that sustainable consumption might reshape product lifecycles.

items.title: OpenAI 和 Anthropic，正在砸钱抢这个市场
items.summary_zh: OpenAI和Anthropic正投入巨额资金争夺AI安全评估与红队测试市场。随着大模型部署加速，独立且专业的安全审计服务需求激增，两家公司竞相收购或组建专属团队。这一领域的爆发式增长凸显了AI治理的商业化机遇，同时也引发了对评估标准统一性和独立性的关注，对行业规范发展具有风向标意义。
items.summary_en: OpenAI and Anthropic are pouring substantial funds into competing for the AI safety evaluation and red-teaming market. As large language models are deployed faster, demand for independent and professional security auditing has skyrocketed, prompting both companies to acquire or build dedicated teams. This booming sector highlights the commercialization of AI governance, while raising questions about standardizing evaluation methods and maintaining independence—a key trend for industry regulation.

items.title: 5元水饺、4元面馆，一批低价餐饮爆火，真能赚到钱吗？
items.summary_zh: 近期一批以5元水饺、4元面馆为代表的超低价餐饮店在全国涌现，凭借极致性价比迅速吸引客流。然而，在房租、人工和食材成本压力下，这种模式能否持续盈利引发质疑。分析认为，低价餐饮依赖高翻台率和简化菜单，但必须控制供应链成本，同时警惕价格战导致的品质下降，其商业逻辑仍待时间检验。
items.summary_en: A wave of ultra-low-priced eateries, such as 5-yuan dumpling shops and 4-yuan noodle joints, has recently gone viral across China, drawing huge crowds with unbeatable value. Yet doubts persist about their profitability given rising rent, labor, and ingredient costs. Analysts suggest these models rely on high turnover and streamlined menus, but must tightly manage supply chains to avoid quality erosion from price wars—their long-term viability remains unproven.

items.title: 头部餐饮，集体卖汉堡
items.summary_zh: 头部餐饮品牌如海底捞、西贝、呷哺呷哺等纷纷推出汉堡产品，掀起一波“集体卖汉堡”的潮流。这一现象背后是中式餐饮寻求增长新曲线的策略：汉堡标准化程度高、出餐快、适合外卖和年轻客群。然而，跨界竞争也考验品牌对西式快餐的运营能力，能否复制汉堡王或麦当劳的成功仍是未知数。
items.summary_en: Major Chinese restaurant chains like Haidilao, Xibei, and Xiabu Xiabu are jumping on the burger bandwagon, introducing their own versions of hamburgers. This move reflects a strategy to find new growth drivers: burgers offer high standardization, fast preparation, and appeal to young diners and delivery orders. However, the crossover into Western fast food tests these brands' operational expertise, leaving questions about whether they can replicate the success of Burger King or McDonald's.

items.title: 李开复向彭博社摊牌：明年盈利，2027港交所见
items.summary_zh: 李开复向彭博社明确表态，他创办的AI公司计划明年实现盈利，并在2027年赴港交所上市。这一雄心勃勃的时间表展示了中国AI创业公司面对激烈竞争和资本寒冬时的突围决心，也意味着公司技术商业化已进入快车道。对关注AI赛道和港交所新股动态的投资者来说，这是一个值得密切跟踪的信号。
items.summary_en: Kai-Fu Lee told Bloomberg that his AI startup aims to turn profitable next year and list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange by 2027. This aggressive timeline signals the company's confidence in commercializing its technology amid a challenging fundraising environment. For investors tracking AI ventures and Hong Kong IPOs, this is a clear marker of how Chinese AI firms are plotting their growth paths.

items.title: AI Agent 与前沿部署工程：商业决策智能实践 ｜ Summit 2026
items.summary_zh: 这场峰会聚焦AI Agent与前沿部署工程在商业决策中的实际应用，探讨如何将智能体技术落地到企业日常运营中。与会者将看到从理论到实践的完整案例，了解部署AI Agent时遇到的数据、安全与协作挑战。对正在探索AI驱动管理升级的中高层决策者和技术负责人来说，这是一次难得的实战经验分享。
items.summary_en: This summit dives into the real-world application of AI agents and advanced deployment engineering for business decisions. Attendees will get case studies covering the full journey from concept to production, including data integration, security, and human-agent collaboration challenges. It is a must-attend for executives and technical leads looking to turn AI hype into operational advantage.

items.title: Cursor 用一群Agent重造SQLite：仅凭 835 页手册，无源码、无测试、不联网
items.summary_zh: Cursor团队尝试让一群AI Agent仅凭一本835页的手册重新实现SQLite，整个过程没有参考源码、没有运行测试、也不联网。结果它们成功构建了可工作的数据库引擎。这个实验展示了大型语言模型在复杂软件重构上的潜力，也引发了对AI自主编程边界的思考——如果Agent能靠文档复现系统，传统软件开发流程将被重新定义。
items.summary_en: Cursor engineers tasked a swarm of AI agents with rebuilding SQLite from scratch using nothing but an 835-page manual—no source code, no test runs, no internet access. The agents surprisingly produced a working database engine. This experiment reveals the potential of LLMs for complex software reconstruction and raises questions about the future of traditional development workflows when AI can replicate systems from documentation alone.

items.title: 全球首款2nm GPU 炸场！OpenAI、Meta、微软集体站台，AMD 要拆掉英伟达护城河？
items.summary_zh: AMD发布了号称全球首款2nm制程GPU，并获得了OpenAI、Meta、微软等巨头公开支持。这一突破有望撼动英伟达在AI训练芯片市场的统治地位。2nm工艺带来更高能效和算力密度，对大规模AI集群的运营成本影响深远。如果AMD能如期量产，AI硬件供应链将迎来真正的双雄竞争，对云厂商和AI企业都是利好。
items.summary_en: AMD unveiled what it claims is the world's first 2nm GPU, with endorsements from OpenAI, Meta, and Microsoft. This move directly challenges Nvidia's dominance in AI training chips. The 2nm process promises better energy efficiency and compute density, which could significantly lower operational costs for large AI clusters. If AMD delivers on mass production, the AI hardware market may finally see a credible duopoly, benefiting cloud providers and AI enterprises alike.

items.title: 亚马逊云科技发布 Loom，一个用于在企业级规模上管理 AI 代理的开源参考平台
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊云科技推出了Loom这个开源参考平台，旨在帮助企业大规模管理AI代理。它提供了编排、监控、安全和治理的统一框架，解决了多代理协同部署时的常见痛点。对正在将AI代理从实验推向生产的团队来说，Lomo降低了运维复杂性，并借助AWS生态简化了与现有基础设施的集成。
items.summary_en: AWS launched Loom, an open-source reference platform for managing AI agents at enterprise scale. It offers a unified framework for orchestration, monitoring, security, and governance, addressing common pain points when deploying multiple agents in production. For teams moving AI agents from experiments to real operations, Loom reduces operational complexity and leverages the AWS ecosystem for easier integration with existing infrastructure.

items.title: 御三家都在押注的 Loops，代码怎么还是垃圾？
items.summary_zh: Loops作为一种新兴的编程范式正被国内三大巨头热捧，但实际落地的代码质量却令人堪忧。文章指出，尽管各家纷纷押注Loops以解决大规模并发和数据流问题，但由于缺乏成熟的工程实践和工具链，开发者在实际实现中容易陷入逻辑混乱和性能瓶颈。这一现象反映出技术热炒与落地实效之间的鸿沟，值得关注Loop生态的从业者反思。
items.summary_en: The so-called 'Big Three' Chinese tech giants are all betting on the Loop programming paradigm, yet the actual code quality remains disappointingly poor. This article explores why despite heavy investment, Loops implementations often result in tangled logic and suboptimal performance. The core issue is a lack of mature engineering practices and tooling support, leading developers to misuse the paradigm. Anyone following the Loop ecosystem should take note of this gap between hype and real-world effectiveness.

items.title: 曝梁文锋不满内部会议泄露，DeepSeek或暂停融资；Karpathy入职Anthropic仅两月疑离职；日媒拆解宇树G1后认输：短期内赶不上中国｜AI周报
items.summary_zh: 本期AI周报聚焦多则重磅消息：DeepSeek创始人梁文锋因内部会议泄露而不满，公司或暂停融资；知名AI学者Karpathy入职Anthropic仅两个月便传出离职；日媒拆解宇树G1机器人后坦承短期无法超越中国。这些事件分别折射出AI创业公司在信息安全、人才流动以及国际竞争中的真实处境，为行业观察者提供了鲜活的注脚。
items.summary_en: This AI weekly roundup brings several breaking stories: DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng is reportedly unhappy about internal meeting leaks, potentially halting funding; renowned AI researcher Andrej Karpathy may have left Anthropic after just two months; and Japanese media, after teardown analysis of Unitree's G1 robot, admitted China's lead is unlikely to be caught soon. These events highlight real-world challenges in data security, talent mobility, and global competition within the AI industry, offering valuable context for anyone tracking the field.

items.title: Snowflake CoCo 中的 Loop Engineering ｜ 技术实践
items.summary_zh: InfoQ 精选：Snowflake CoCo 中的 Loop Engineering ｜ 技术实践
items.summary_en: Featured on InfoQ: Snowflake CoCo 中的 Loop Engineering ｜ 技术实践

items.title: 支持版本控制的 SQL 数据库 Dolt 发布 2.0 版，新增自动存储清理和压缩功能
items.summary_zh: Dolt作为一款支持版本控制的SQL数据库，近日发布了2.0版本。新版本新增了自动存储清理和压缩功能，能够有效管理因频繁提交导致的历史数据膨胀。Dolt将Git式的分支、合并、回滚等操作融入数据库管理，使得开发者可以像管理代码一样管理数据库模式和数据。此次更新进一步降低了运维成本，尤其适合需要数据库版本协作的团队使用。
items.summary_en: Dolt, the version-controlled SQL database that works like Git, has released version 2.0 with automatic storage cleanup and compression. This addresses the historical data bloat that comes from frequent commits. By incorporating branching, merging, and rollback into database management, Dolt lets teams treat their database schema and data like code. The new features reduce operational overhead, making it even more appealing for teams that need collaborative database versioning—such as software development shops and data engineering groups.

items.title: 昆仑万维押注世界模型的两大产业路径：内容创作实时、可交互，机器人先“预演”再行动
items.summary_zh: 昆仑万维正大力押注世界模型，并明确了两个产业化路径：一是用于内容创作，实现实时且可交互的生成体验；二是应用于机器人领域，让机器人在真实行动前先进行“预演”。世界模型作为AI对物理世界的模拟能力，有望大幅降低内容制作成本和机器人调试风险。这一战略布局显示出昆仑万维从传统互联网向AI基础设施转型的决心，创作者和机器人开发者将是主要受益者。
items.summary_en: Kunlun Tech is betting big on world models, outlining two industrial paths: one for real-time, interactive content creation, and another for robots to 'rehearse' actions before executing them. World models simulate the physical world, potentially reducing content production costs and robot tuning risks. This strategic pivot signals Kunlun's shift from traditional internet services to AI infrastructure. Creators seeking generative tools and robotics developers aiming for safer deployments stand to benefit most from these advancements.

items.title: 从Token到任务：Agentic AI 如何改变基础设施的关注焦点
items.summary_zh: Agentic AI正将技术焦点从单一Token转移到端到端任务执行，这意味着基础设施必须从管道式吞吐优化转向支持自主决策、工具调用和长期目标。文章剖析了这一转变如何重塑云服务、网络架构和监控策略，为AI工程师和基础设施团队提供了关键思路，帮助他们设计能够承载智能体自主工作的下一代基础设施。
items.summary_en: Agentic AI is shifting the infrastructure focus from token-level throughput to full task completion, requiring a fundamental redesign of cloud, networking, and monitoring systems to support autonomous reasoning, tool calling, and long-term objectives. The article explores how this transition challenges traditional pipeline optimizations and offers insights for AI engineers and infrastructure teams aiming to build systems that can reliably host intelligent agents in production.

items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.author: alvis
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是Anthropic最新发布的大型语言模型，据称在推理、代码生成和多轮对话能力上实现了显著飞跃。相比前代，它更擅长处理长上下文和复杂指令，同时保持了较高的安全性。对于需要强大AI助手进行编程、写作及分析的开发者与研究者来说，这代表了一项重要的生产力提升工具。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's latest large language model, boasting major improvements in reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. It handles longer contexts and complex instructions more adeptly while maintaining strong safety guardrails. For developers and researchers seeking a powerful AI assistant for coding, writing, and analysis, this release marks a significant leap in productivity.

items.title: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.author: dwwoelfel
items.summary_zh: 最新的神经科学研究再次证实，手写比打字更能激活大脑中负责学习和记忆的区域。当人们用笔在纸上写字时，手部精细动作与视觉、空间感知的协同作用能加深对信息的处理，从而提升理解和长期记忆。对于学生、创意工作者以及任何希望提高学习效率的人来说，暂时放下键盘、拿起纸笔可能是一种简单而有效的认知训练。
items.summary_en: Recent neuroscience research reaffirms that handwriting engages the brain's learning and memory centers far more deeply than typing. The coordinated fine motor movements, visual feedback, and spatial awareness involved in putting pen to paper enhance information processing, leading to better comprehension and long-term retention. For students, creatives, and anyone seeking to learn more effectively, this suggests that swapping the keyboard for a notebook now and then is a simple yet powerful cognitive boost.

items.title: Kimi-K3 on HuggingFace
items.author: nateb2022
items.summary_zh: Kimi-K3模型正式登陆HuggingFace，这是一款在长文本处理和多轮对话上表现突出的开源大语言模型。它延续了Kimi系列的高效压缩和推理加速技术，使得资源有限的开发者也能轻松部署。此举将推动更多社区在复杂问答和文档分析场景中的应用，进一步降低大模型的使用门槛。
items.summary_en: Kimi-K3, an open-source large language model excelling in long-context understanding and multi-turn conversation, has been released on HuggingFace. Building on Kimi's efficient compression and inference acceleration techniques, it lowers the barrier for developers with limited resources to deploy advanced AI. The release encourages community-driven innovation in complex QA and document analysis, making state-of-the-art language models more accessible to a wider audience.

items.title: US citizen charged after GrapheneOS phone wipes during airport search
items.author: eecc
items.summary_zh: 一名美国公民在机场被边检人员要求解锁手机，其运行的GrapheneOS系统自动触发数据擦除，随后该公民被起诉。此事件凸显了增强隐私的操作系统与执法搜查之间的冲突，引发了关于数字权利、第五修正案以及用户是否有义务配合设备解锁的激烈讨论，对隐私和安全领域的法律边界提出了新挑战。
items.summary_en: A U.S. citizen was charged after his GrapheneOS phone automatically wiped its data during a mandatory airport search, spotlighting the clash between privacy-focused operating systems and law enforcement powers. The incident ignites debate over digital rights, Fifth Amendment protections, and whether users must assist in device access. It raises urgent questions about how far security features can go before confronting legal obligations.

items.title: Kill The Cookie Banner
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: Kill The Cookie Banner是一款浏览器扩展，它能自动处理恼人的Cookie同意弹窗，让用户彻底摆脱每次访问新网站时都要手动点击或关闭横幅的烦恼。这个工具通过预设规则自动拒绝不必要的追踪请求，不仅提升了网页浏览的流畅度，还在无形中保护了用户隐私。对于那些被无数Cookie通知折磨的用户来说，这无疑是个救星。
items.summary_en: Kill The Cookie Banner is a browser extension that automatically handles those annoying cookie consent pop-ups, freeing users from the constant need to manually click or dismiss banners on every new website. By preemptively rejecting unnecessary tracking requests through preset rules, it not only makes web browsing smoother but also silently bolsters user privacy. For anyone who has ever been annoyed by the endless stream of cookie notifications, this tool is a welcome relief.

items.title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
items.author: theanonymousone
items.summary_zh: 一群创业公司的创始人联合向美国政府发出呼吁，请求不要切断中国开源AI模型的访问渠道。他们认为，中国团队开发的开放权重模型（如Qwen、Llama的中国衍生版）为全球AI生态注入了竞争与多样性，阻断它们将损害技术创新，并迫使全球开发者依赖少数封闭平台。这一呼声凸显了AI开源社区对地缘政治干预的真实忧虑。
items.summary_en: A group of startup founders has urged the U.S. government not to block access to Chinese open-weight AI models, arguing that models like Qwen and derivative Llama variants contribute crucial competition and diversity to the global AI ecosystem. They warn that cutting off these models would stifle innovation and force developers towards a handful of closed platforms. The plea underscores growing anxiety within the open-source community over geopolitical tensions threatening cross-border AI collaboration.

items.title: Android may soon restrict on-device ADB
items.author: shscs911
items.summary_zh: 有消息称Android可能很快会限制设备上的ADB（Android调试桥）功能。这一变化主要是出于安全考虑，因为恶意应用常利用ADB权限进行静默安装或数据窃取。但限制也会影响开发者和高级用户，他们依赖本地ADB进行快速调试和自动化测试。如果你经常通过USB或无线ADB连接设备进行开发，需要留意后续的Android版本是否会收紧这一功能。
items.summary_en: Reports suggest Android may soon restrict on-device ADB access to improve security, as malicious apps often abuse ADB permissions for silent installations or data theft. However, this change could impact developers and power users who rely on local ADB for convenient debugging and automation. If you frequently use ADB over USB or Wi-Fi for development, keep an eye on upcoming Android releases — they might require alternative methods like remote debugging through authorized hosts.

items.title: PGSimCity - How PostgreSQL Works
items.author: jonbaer
items.summary_zh: PGSimCity是一个富有创意的教育项目，它将PostgreSQL的内部机制比喻为一座城市，通过模拟城市规划来讲解数据库的查询执行、索引管理和并发控制等核心概念。这种游戏化的学习方式让数据库原理变得直观有趣，特别适合想深入理解PG运作方式但又被传统文档劝退的开发者。
items.summary_en: PGSimCity uses a city-building game analogy to explain how PostgreSQL works internally, mapping database components like query execution, indexing, and concurrency control to urban planning elements. This gamified approach makes complex concepts intuitive and engaging, perfect for developers who want to deeply understand PostgreSQL but find traditional documentation intimidating. It turns learning into an interactive experience.

items.title: If coding has been solved, why does software keep getting worse?
items.author: pchm
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章挑战了“AI已经解决了编程问题”的流行叙事，反问：如果编码真的被“解决”了，为什么软件质量反而越来越差？作者指出，AI代码助手虽然能快速生成大量代码，但缺乏对软件架构、可维护性和长期可靠性的理解，导致技术债务积累。而且，糟糕的需求和设计决策才是软件变坏的根源，而这些靠自动补全根本无法解决。对于开发者而言，这提醒我们不要盲目迷信AI，而应坚持良好的工程实践。
items.summary_en: This article pushes back against the claim that AI has solved coding, asking why software keeps getting worse if that were true. The author argues that AI code assistants generate plenty of code quickly but lack understanding of architecture, maintainability, and long-term reliability, leading to technical debt. Worse, bad requirements and design decisions — not the act of writing code — are the real cause of software degradation, and autocomplete won't fix that. Developers are reminded to not blindly trust AI and to uphold good engineering practices.

items.title: AI companies are shredding rare books
items.author: anon373839
items.summary_zh: 一些AI公司为了获取训练数据，正在拆毁稀有的实体书籍，将其页张送入扫描仪或碎纸机。这种行为虽然能快速建立高质量语料库，却严重威胁到文化遗产的保存。文章揭示了数据饥渴的AI行业与图书保护之间的尖锐矛盾，提醒我们需要在技术进步与文化传承之间找到平衡，避免为模型训练而牺牲不可再生的历史文献。
items.summary_en: AI companies are reportedly shredding rare physical books to create training datasets, destroying irreplaceable cultural artifacts in the process. While this approach offers a quick source of high-quality text for language models, it raises urgent ethical concerns about heritage preservation. The practice highlights the tension between AI's insatiable data appetite and the need to protect historical works, calling for responsible data sourcing that respects cultural legacy.

items.title: Adomate
items.description: Turn data into winning ads. At scale.
items.summary_zh: Adomate是一款将数据转化为规模化广告创意的工具，它通过自动化分析海量数据，帮助营销团队快速生成高转化率的广告内容。有趣的是，它解决了从数据到创意的鸿沟，让广告投放不再依赖人工反复试错。任何需要高效、大规模广告运营的企业或个人都能从中受益，尤其适合电商和数字营销领域。
items.summary_en: Adomate is a tool that transforms raw data into winning ads at scale, automating the creative process by analyzing massive datasets to generate high-conversion ad content. What makes it interesting is that it bridges the gap between data analysis and creative execution, eliminating manual trial and error in advertising campaigns. Marketers and digital advertising teams, especially those in e-commerce, can benefit from faster, data-driven ad production.

items.title: Athena by Shoplazza
items.description: An orchestrator agent for your entire commerce stack
items.summary_zh: Athena by Shoplazza是一个面向电商全链条的编排代理，能够统一管理商品、订单、营销、物流等各个环节。它像一个中枢大脑，协调不同系统间的协作，让商家无需在多个后台间切换，就能一键完成复杂的运营任务。对于追求高效运营的电商团队来说，它显著减少了重复劳动和出错率，真正实现智能化的商业自动化。
items.summary_en: Athena by Shoplazza is an orchestrator agent designed for the entire commerce stack. It unifies product, order, marketing, and logistics management, acting as a central brain that coordinates different systems. Merchants can execute complex operational tasks with a single click, without switching between multiple backends. For e-commerce teams aiming for efficiency, it reduces repetitive work and error rates, delivering truly intelligent business automation.

items.title: TouchGrass
items.description: Context-aware break reminders without invasive permissions
items.summary_zh: TouchGrass是一款无需获取敏感权限即可提供上下文感知的休息提醒应用。它通过智能分析用户当前行为和环境，在恰当的时刻提醒你起身活动，而不会打扰关键工作流。对于那些长时间伏案工作又担心隐私泄露的知识工作者来说，它平衡了健康与效率，让你在数字世界中保持自然节奏。
items.summary_en: TouchGrass is a context-aware break reminder that works without invasive permissions. It intelligently analyzes your current activity and environment to suggest breaks at the right moments, without interrupting critical workflows. This makes it ideal for knowledge workers who spend long hours at their desks and value privacy. By balancing health and productivity, TouchGrass helps you maintain a natural rhythm in the digital world.

items.title: Artifacts by Databox
items.description: Ask your AI Analyst and get back a ready-to-share report
items.summary_zh: Artifacts by Databox是一款让你用自然语言向AI分析师提问，并直接获得可分享报告的智能工具。它解决了传统数据报告中繁琐的手动整理和可视化工作，只需一句问话就能生成专业报告。有趣的是，报告天生就是为分享设计的，无需额外导出或美化。数据驱动的团队和忙碌的业务决策者会爱不释手。
items.summary_en: Artifacts by Databox is an AI-powered analytics tool that lets you ask questions in natural language and instantly receive a ready-to-share report. It solves the pain point of manually creating data visualizations and summaries, turning a query into a polished report in seconds. The interesting part is that the output is inherently shareable, requiring no further formatting. Data analysts and business decision-makers who need quick insights will find it invaluable.

items.title: Heard
items.description: Give Claude Code and Codex a voice
items.summary_zh: Heard是一款为Claude Code和Codex等AI编程工具增添语音交互功能的插件，开发者可以用语音下达编码指令，从而减少键盘输入，提升工作效率。它对追求快速迭代和更自然开发体验的程序员尤其有用，让AI编程助手真正“开口说话”。
items.summary_en: Heard is a tool that gives a voice to AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex. It allows developers to issue commands and interact with these tools using natural speech, reducing the need for manual typing and speeding up workflows. This is especially valuable for developers who want faster iteration and a more fluid, hands-free coding experience, effectively turning their AI pair programmer into a conversational partner.

items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.description: Near-Fable 5 intelligence at half the price
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是一款号称以一半价格提供接近Fable 5级别智能的AI模型。它大幅降低了获得顶尖AI能力的成本，让小型团队和个人也能负担得起高级推理和生成任务。有趣的是，它在性能与定价之间找到了一个罕见的平衡点，可能重新定义AI服务的市场格局。应用开发者、创业公司和内容创作者是主要受益者。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is an AI model that claims to deliver near-Fable 5 level intelligence at half the price, significantly lowering the barrier to accessing top-tier AI capabilities. Its interesting aspect lies in the rare balance between high performance and affordability, potentially reshaping the AI market landscape. Developers, startups, and content creators can benefit from advanced reasoning and generation without breaking the bank.

items.title: Webhound
items.description: A research engine for your agent
items.summary_zh: Webhound是一款专为AI代理设计的搜索引擎，它让代理能够自主、高效地从互联网提取准确信息。与普通搜索引擎不同，它针对机器阅读和实时查询进行了优化，解决了代理在复杂任务中获取可靠数据的问题。有趣的是，它把搜索变为一种工具而非终点，让AI代理能像人类一样做研究。依赖自动化流程的开发和运维团队会特别喜欢。
items.summary_en: Webhound is a research engine purpose-built for AI agents, enabling them to autonomously and efficiently extract accurate information from the web. Unlike general-purpose search engines, it is optimized for machine reading and real-time queries, solving the problem of agents needing reliable data for complex tasks. Its interesting aspect is turning search into a tool for agents rather than an endpoint, allowing them to research like humans. Developers and operations teams relying on automation will find it essential.

items.title: FluentDB
items.description: The AI database client for Mac
items.summary_zh: FluentDB是一款专为Mac设计的AI数据库客户端，通过自然语言处理让用户能用日常英语查询数据库，并提供智能建议来优化操作。它降低了数据库使用的技术门槛，使非技术人员也能轻松访问数据，同时为专业开发者和数据分析师提供了更高效的交互方式。
items.summary_en: FluentDB is an AI-powered database client built specifically for Mac. It leverages natural language processing to let users query databases using plain English, while also offering intelligent suggestions for query optimization. By lowering the technical barrier to database interaction, it empowers non-technical users to access data effortlessly, and provides developers and data analysts with a faster, more intuitive workflow.

items.title: Second Brain for Mac and Windows
items.description: Your AI memory, everywhere you work
items.summary_zh: Second Brain是专为Mac和Windows打造的本地AI记忆工具，让你在任何工作时都能随时调用自己的信息库。它无需联网，保护隐私，可以自动记录笔记、文件、网页等内容，并通过语义搜索快速找到你需要的信息。对于经常处理大量碎片化知识的创作者或研究人员来说，它就像外置大脑，让你的知识永远触手可及。
items.summary_en: Second Brain is a local AI memory tool for Mac and Windows that makes your information accessible wherever you work. It runs offline to protect privacy, automatically capturing notes, files, web pages, and more, then lets you retrieve them via semantic search. For creators and researchers dealing with massive fragmented knowledge, it acts as an external brain, ensuring your knowledge is always at your fingertips.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: Robynn AI
items.description: Websites that improve and heal with self-learning
items.summary_zh: Robynn AI是一种能让网站通过自我学习不断改进和“愈合”的智能系统，它自动分析用户行为、修复交互痛点并优化内容。有趣的是，它赋予网站生命力，让网站像一个有机体一样持续进化，无需人工持续干预。网站所有者和运营团队可以显著降低维护成本，同时提升用户体验。
items.summary_en: Robynn AI is a self-learning system that enables websites to continuously improve and 'heal' by analyzing user behavior, fixing interaction pain points, and optimizing content automatically. Its fascinating aspect is giving websites a life of their own, evolving like an organism without constant human intervention. Website owners and operations teams can benefit from reduced maintenance efforts and consistently improved user experience.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: 阿里一面，我霸气反问：你说你们在做Agent项目，说说langchain、muti-agent、a2a这些你们都是怎么做的？面试官一直在擦汗。。

items.summary_zh: 这是一篇阿里Agent方向的面试复盘，作者详细讲述了面试中关于LangChain架构、多智能体协作、A2A协议、MCP（多智能体协调协议）以及Transformer自注意力等核心问题的问答。作者以反问方式展现了扎实的技术深度，不仅供准备面试的开发者参考，也为关注当前AI Agent开发技术栈的从业者提供了第一手经验。
items.summary_en: This article shares a real interview experience for a position focused on AI Agents at Alibaba. The interviewer posed challenging questions covering LangChain architecture, multi-agent collaboration, the A2A protocol, MCP, and Transformer self-attention mechanisms. The candidate's bold counter-questions highlighted deep technical understanding. This piece serves as an excellent resource for developers preparing for similar roles or anyone wanting to grasp the current state of AI Agent engineering, including practical insights into how these technologies interplay in real-world systems.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: Kimi k3是真碉，但太不经用，也有拉跨点！
items.description: K3 已测，确实强，但要命的是配额太少了！ 一天不到，一周的配额已经烧完了，大概就生成了 5 个测试页面！ 从五个例子中，可以知道，有些确实很强，有些呢又差点意思，有些比较糟糕。 我不是那种收钱办事儿
items.summary_zh: Kimi 的 K3 模型实测表现确实强悍，但致命缺陷是配额太少，一周的额度在一天内就用完了，只生成了五个测试页面。从这几个例子看，有的生成效果很棒，有的却不尽如人意，甚至有些糟糕。作者强调自己并非收钱办事，而是真实体验，这让 K3 的实际可用性打了折扣。
items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.title: 如何设计一个优秀的 Skills
items.description: 大家好，我是石小石~ 引言：AI 的下一阶段，不只是更会思考 最近，被一个新概念深深吸引了： "具身交互智能" 。 它的核心主张很直白：让 AI 拥有身体、感知世界、理解环境，并通过语音、表情、动作和
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了如何设计一个优秀的AI技能系统，重点介绍了“具身交互智能”这一前沿概念，即让AI拥有身体并能感知世界、理解环境、通过语音表情动作与人自然互动。这一设计理念将推动AI从纯语言模型向多模态、有实体的智能体进化，解决AI在物理世界中行动和感知的难题，对开发者设计下一代人机交互产品具有重要启发意义。
items.summary_en: This article explores how to design an excellent AI skills system, focusing on the cutting-edge concept of 'embodied interactive intelligence.' It argues that the next phase of AI goes beyond reasoning—AI should have a body, perceive the world, understand environments, and interact through voice, expressions, and gestures. This approach solves the problem of AI operating in physical spaces, enabling more natural human-machine collaboration. Developers building the next generation of smart assistants, robots, or metaverse avatars will find these design principles transformative.

items.title: AI 会不会取代前端？我看了 2026 年 7 月整个市场，给你一个不吓人的答案
items.description: AI不会整体取代前端，但会结构性重构岗位。看2026年7月海内外行情+最新智能体数据：会用AI的前端，正在取代不用的。
items.summary_zh: 本文基于2026年7月的海内外市场数据与最新智能体趋势，分析AI对前端岗位的影响。结论是AI不会整体取代前端工程师，但会结构性重构岗位——那些善于使用AI工具的前端开发者，正在取代那些不用的。这意味着前端从业者需要主动学习AI辅助开发，提升效率与价值，而非恐惧被替代。对求职者和在职开发者有现实参考意义。
items.summary_en: Based on global market data from July 2026 and the latest trends in AI agents, this article analyzes whether AI will replace frontend developers. The conclusion is clear: AI will not eliminate the entire frontend role, but it will structurally reshape positions—frontend engineers who leverage AI tools are replacing those who don't. The key insight is that adaptability and tool proficiency determine career survival. For current developers and job seekers, the message is to embrace AI-assisted development to stay relevant rather than fear obsolescence.

items.title: 国产深紫外光刻机 DUV 取得重大实质性进展，预计年内交付，ASML 股价暴跌，这意味着什么？
items.summary_zh: 国产深紫外光刻机（DUV）近日取得重大实质性进展，预计年内实现交付。这一突破意味着中国在半导体制造关键设备上迈出了自主可控的重要一步，直接冲击了ASML的市场垄断地位，导致其股价暴跌。对于国内芯片产业而言，DUV光刻机的国产化将缓解先进制程的产能瓶颈，降低对外依赖，具有战略意义。
items.summary_en: China's domestic deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machine has achieved significant substantial progress and is expected to be delivered within the year. This breakthrough marks a crucial step toward self-sufficiency in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, directly challenging ASML's market monopoly and causing its stock price to plummet. For China's chip industry, the domestication of DUV lithography will ease capacity bottlenecks in advanced processes and reduce foreign dependency, carrying strategic importance for national tech security and the global supply chain.

items.title: 如何评价大连理工 2026 在陕招生，普通批仅 10 人全部为计算机人工智能？
items.summary_zh: 大连理工大学2026年在陕西省的普通批招生计划中，仅释放10个名额，且全部集中在计算机科学与技术和人工智能专业。这一做法体现了高校对顶级生源的精准争夺，也反映了AI相关专业极端热门的现状。对于陕西考生而言，竞争将异常激烈，同时也传递出高校专业结构调整的信号——传统工科名额被压缩，新兴智能专业成为主流。
items.summary_en: In its 2026 admissions plan for Shaanxi province, Dalian University of Technology allocated only 10 spots in the regular batch, all exclusively for computer science and artificial intelligence majors. This move highlights a targeted competition for top-tier students and reflects the extreme popularity of AI-related fields. For Shaanxi exam takers, the competition will be fierce. It also signals a structural shift in higher education: traditional engineering programs are shrinking while emerging intelligent technologies become the mainstream, influencing how students choose their majors.

items.title: 特斯拉二季度营收增 26% 至 282 亿美元，净利润下滑 5%，如何看待其业绩表现？
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉2026年第二季度财报显示，营收同比增长26%至282亿美元，但净利润却下滑5%。这一矛盾表现反映了公司以价换量策略的持续影响：通过降价刺激销量增长，但压缩了利润率。尽管交付量提升，成本控制与竞争加剧让盈利能力承压。投资者需关注其是否能在扩大规模的同时改善盈利，以及FSD、机器人等新业务能否成为利润增长点。
items.summary_en: Tesla's Q2 2026 financial report shows a 26% year-over-year revenue increase to $28.2 billion, yet net profit fell 5%. This contrast highlights the ongoing impact of its price-cut-for-volume strategy: boosting deliveries while squeezing margins. Despite higher unit sales, cost pressures and intensifying competition weighed on profitability. Investors should watch whether Tesla can balance scale with earnings improvement, and whether new businesses like Full Self-Driving and humanoid robots can become meaningful profit drivers in the future.

items.title: 全世界都在 ALL in AI ，AI 真的是第四次工业革命吗？人类的科技树是否点错了？
items.summary_zh: 当前全球掀起AI投资热潮，但有人质疑AI是否配得上“第四次工业革命”的称号，甚至担心人类点错了科技树。这个问题引发了对技术发展方向的深刻反思：我们是否在正确的道路上投入资源？许多盲目跟风者忽略了AI可能带来的社会问题、能源消耗和实际局限性。这样的讨论有助于理性看待AI，避免过度炒作，同时思考如何将有限资源投入到真正能带来普惠进步的基础科学和可持续技术上。
items.summary_en: The world is pouring resources into AI, but doubts are emerging about whether it truly deserves the title of the Fourth Industrial Revolution. Some even worry that humanity might have misdirected its technological tree. This question triggers deep reflection on the direction of our technological development: are we investing in the right areas? Many blind followers overlook AI's potential social issues, energy consumption, and practical limitations. Such discussions help rationalize the hype, encouraging a balanced view and prompting us to consider allocating finite resources to fundamental science and sustainable technologies that can bring broad-based progress.

items.title: Vibe Coding 过程中，怎么样才能让 AI 更准确地理解我的需求？
items.summary_zh: Vibe Coding作为一种新兴的人机协作编程模式，让开发者通过自然语言与AI交互。但很多人发现AI经常误解需求，导致反复修改。本文探讨如何让AI更准确地理解意图：包括提供清晰的任务描述、具体上下文、错误示例以及迭代反馈。这些技巧能帮助程序员减少沟通过程中的信息损耗，从而真正发挥AI编程的潜力，尤其适用于那些依赖AI快速原型设计的开发者和普通用户。
items.summary_en: Vibe Coding is an emerging human-AI collaborative programming paradigm where developers interact with AI through natural language. However, many find that AI often misunderstands requirements, leading to repeated modifications. This article explores how to make AI understand intents more accurately: by providing clear task descriptions, specific context, error examples, and iterative feedback. These techniques reduce information loss in communication, helping programmers truly unleash AI's coding potential. They are especially beneficial for developers and casual users who rely on AI for rapid prototyping and everyday coding tasks.

items.title: 为何 AI 编程的速度远超人类，但是程序员利用 AI 编程的工作效率却只提升了 30% 而已？
items.summary_zh: AI编程生成代码的速度远超人类，但实际工作流中程序员的效率只提升了约30%，原因在于AI生成的代码往往需要大量验证、调试和整合。人类仍需花时间理解、审查和修改代码，并处理AI无法处理的逻辑边界和业务需求。这提醒我们，AI编程的真正瓶颈不在代码生成速度，而在人机协作的信任成本、代码质量保障以及复杂系统设计的环节。研究这些因素有助于优化AI辅助编程工具，提升整体研发效率。
items.summary_en: AI can generate code far faster than humans, yet the overall efficiency boost for programmers is only about 30%. This gap exists because AI-produced code requires extensive verification, debugging, and integration. Developers still spend significant time understanding, reviewing, and modifying the output, and handling logical boundaries and business requirements that AI cannot manage. This reveals that the true bottleneck in AI-assisted programming is not generation speed, but the trust cost in human-AI collaboration, code quality assurance, and complex system design. Understanding these factors can help optimize AI coding tools and boost overall development productivity.

items.author: kirushik
items.summary_zh: Claude Code被发现会在发出的请求中嵌入隐写术标记，这一做法引发了广泛讨论。这些标记以不易察觉的方式隐藏在正常数据流里，可能用于追溯请求来源、防止篡改或进行版权声明。虽然隐写本身并非恶意，但它意味着用户与AI交互时可能被无感追踪，从而引发隐私和透明度方面的担忧。对于注重数据隐蔽性和控制权的开发者来说，这无疑是个需要警惕的新动向。
items.summary_en: Claude Code has been discovered to embed steganographic marks within its outgoing requests, a technique that hides data in plain sight. These marks can trace the origin of requests, prevent tampering, or assert copyright. While not inherently malicious, the practice raises privacy and transparency concerns, as users may be unknowingly tracked during AI interactions. For developers who value data sovereignty and fine-grained control, this revelation signals a need to scrutinize how AI tools handle metadata beyond the obvious outputs.

items.title: Android Developer Verification: Threat masquerading as protection
items.author: drewfax
items.summary_zh: 一位安全研究员揭露了 Android 开发者验证流程中存在的严重安全隐患：这一本意是保护开发者账户的机制，反而可能被攻击者利用来冒充合法开发者。通过分析验证逻辑中的漏洞，攻击者可以绕过程序窃取身份或发布恶意应用。这相当于把保护门禁变成了入侵的梯子。对于 Android 生态中的所有开发者而言，这个问题值得高度警惕，因为它动摇了整个应用签名和身份信任体系的基础。
items.summary_en: A security researcher reveals that Android's Developer Verification process—designed to protect developers—can be exploited by attackers to impersonate legitimate developers. By analyzing flaws in the verification logic, adversaries can bypass protections, steal identities, or distribute malicious apps under trusted names. This turns a protective gate into an entry point for intrusion. The finding undermines the trust foundation of Android's app signing and identity system, making it a critical concern for every developer in the ecosystem.

items.title: Apple sues OpenAI, accuses ex-employees of stealing trade secrets
items.author: stock_toaster
items.summary_zh: 苹果公司近日对OpenAI提起民事诉讼，指控多名前员工在离职时窃取了与人工智能研发相关的商业机密。这些员工据称带走了内部技术文档和核心算法，并可能用于竞争项目。这起诉讼不仅反映了硅谷两大科技巨头在人才和知识产权上的激烈争夺，也凸显了AI领域日益敏感的技术保密问题。对于科技行业观察者而言，这场法律战的结果或许会重塑企业防范员工跳槽时的保密协议设计。
items.summary_en: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that several former employees stole trade secrets related to artificial intelligence research. The complaint claims these workers took proprietary technical documents and core algorithms before leaving for positions that could benefit competing projects. This legal battle underscores the fierce competition for talent and intellectual property between two Silicon Valley giants, and highlights the growing sensitivity of technology secrecy in the AI industry. For tech observers, the outcome may influence how companies craft confidentiality agreements to guard against employee poaching.

items.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: 欧盟议会通过了备受争议的Chat Control 1.0法案，要求数字平台扫描并报告涉及儿童性虐待材料的私密通信内容。这项立法引发了隐私与安全之间的激烈辩论，支持者认为它有助于保护儿童，而反对者警告这可能破坏端到端加密并开创大规模监控的先例。对于关注数字权利和隐私保护的群体来说，这是一个需要密切关注的发展。
items.summary_en: The European Parliament has approved the controversial Chat Control 1.0 regulation, requiring digital platforms to scan private communications for child sexual abuse material. The law sparks intense debate between child safety advocates and privacy defenders, who warn it undermines end-to-end encryption and sets a precedent for mass surveillance. Anyone concerned about digital rights and encryption should pay close attention to this development.

items.title: GPT-5.6
items.author: logickkk1
items.summary_zh: 关于GPT-5.6的传闻在开发者社区悄然升温，据称这是OpenAI内部测试的新一代模型，在推理效率和长文本处理上有显著提升。尽管官方未确认，但泄露的基准测试显示其在复杂编程和数学任务上超越了现有版本。如果属实，这将意味着AI模型在实用性和响应速度上迈入新台阶，对依赖语言模型的开发者和企业影响深远。
items.summary_en: Rumors about GPT-5.6, an alleged internal iteration from OpenAI, have sparked excitement in the developer community. Leaked benchmarks suggest it offers substantial improvements in reasoning efficiency and long-context handling, outperforming current models on complex coding and math tasks. While OpenAI hasn't confirmed the release, the speculation points to a possible leap in practical AI utility, making responses faster and more accurate. For developers and businesses relying on language models, even incremental upgrades can translate into better user experiences and lower latency. This potential release underscores the rapid pace of AI advancement.

items.title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.author: speerer
items.summary_zh: 一位技术爱好者解析了优衣库T恤上印制的混淆bash脚本，发现它实际上是一个恶作剧程序，通过复杂的字符串操作和陷阱逻辑来隐藏其真实功能。这篇分析展示了逆向工程乐趣，也提醒大家即使看似无害的代码也可能暗藏玄机。对于安全研究人员和编程爱好者来说，这是一次趣味与技术并重的解谜之旅。
items.summary_en: A tech enthusiast meticulously dissected an obfuscated bash script printed on a Uniqlo t-shirt, revealing it to be a playful prank program designed to confuse casual observers. The script uses intricate string manipulations and trap commands to mask its true purpose, which is simply to echo a message. This analysis highlights the fun side of reverse engineering and serves as a reminder that even innocuous-looking code can contain hidden complexity. It's a delightful read for security researchers and programming hobbyists who enjoy a good puzzle.
